answer: A travel-agent market helps visitors wander safely from a jetty. To stop fake buyers manufacturing a demand signal, each order pays a nonrefundable platform fee, and any promotional reward is capped at half that fee. New accounts get no separate bonus; refunds cancel rewards before payout. An operator trading between its own Sybil accounts therefore loses money on every loop, regardless of how many keys it creates. The cap must cover all rebates and referral payments together, or an attacker can stack incentives to recover the fee.
